notes: Searching pages, reading blocks, and querying databases run
automatically. Creating or updating a page is write-tier — confirm
before the first write and always show the proposed page title and
parent. Archiving a page is modify-tier because it removes the page
from the default workspace view (Notion's archive is recoverable,
but the page is effectively hidden). Permanently deleting (trashing)
a page or database is destructive-tier — strong explicit
confirmation, every time. Unlisted actions are bumped one tier
above the conservative default per the design doc §6.
